entities.name: Jiří Stanislav Guth-Jarkovský
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jiří Stanislav Guth-Jarkovský was a Czech sports administrator, writer and pedagogue. He is known as the co-author of the Olympic Charter and the first president of the Czech Olympic Committee. During the presidency of Tomáš Masaryk, he was Master of Ceremonies of the President of the Czechoslovak Republic. He is one of the most important figures in Czech sports, culture and administration.
